name: Calibration Benchmark Runner
description: Measures register sensitivity per model by running a comprehensive benchmark suite across multiple task categories (factual, reasoning, code, analysis, creative, instruction) and linguistic registers (direct, casual, technical, academic, narrative). Produces calibrated ModelProfile artifacts for downstream register selection.

types.name: CalibrationRunner

fields.name: _backend
fields.description: Backend implementation providing complete() method for model inference

fields.name: _cache
fields.description: Cache for storing and retrieving ModelProfile artifacts

types.description: Orchestrates register sensitivity benchmarking for a model using a Backend implementation

functions.name: score_response
functions.description: Scores a model response against accept/reject patterns defined in a task dictionary. For reasoning tasks, presence of reject patterns overrides accept matches.

inputs.name: response
inputs.description: The model's response text to evaluate

preconditions: task must contain 'accept' key with list of strings
task must contain 'reject' key (may be empty list)
task must contain 'category' key with string value
postconditions: Returns True if any accept pattern matches AND no reject pattern matches
For reasoning category: returns False if any reject pattern matches, even if accept pattern also matches

functions.name: CalibrationRunner.__init__
functions.description: Initializes CalibrationRunner with a backend and optional profile cache. Creates default ProfileCache if none provided.

inputs.name: profile_cache
inputs.description: Optional profile cache; creates new ProfileCache() if None

preconditions: backend must implement complete(system, messages, max_tokens) method
postconditions: self._backend is set to provided backend
self._cache is set to provided profile_cache or new ProfileCache() instance

functions.name: CalibrationRunner.run
functions.description: Executes synchronous calibration benchmark across all register transforms and tasks. For each (register, task) pair, transforms the prompt, calls backend.complete(), scores the response, and aggregates results into a ModelProfile with per-register and per-category accuracy metrics.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Canonical model name for the profile

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: Override benchmark tasks; defaults to BENCHMARK_TASKS (50+ tasks)

inputs.name: registers
inputs.description: Override registers to test; defaults to all keys in REGISTER_TRANSFORMS

inputs.name: delay
inputs.description: Seconds to sleep between API calls (rate limiting)

error_cases.name: backend_exception
error_cases.condition: self._backend.complete() raises any exception during inference

error_data.handling: Caught and treated as incorrect response (correct=False), continues to next task

preconditions: tasks (if provided) must be list of dicts with 'category', 'prompt', 'accept', 'reject' keys
registers (if provided) must contain keys present in REGISTER_TRANSFORMS
postconditions: Returns ModelProfile with aggregate and per-task accuracies
ModelProfile.calibrated_at is set to current UTC timestamp in ISO format
Profile is saved to cache via self._cache.put(profile)
If verbose=True, progress and summary printed to stdout
side_effects: Calls self._backend.complete() once per (register, task) pair (blocking I/O)
Writes profile to cache directory via self._cache.put()

structured_side_effects.description: Makes synchronous API calls to model backend for each (register, task) pair
Prints progress and summary if verbose=True

performance_budget.complexity: O(R * T) where R = number of registers, T = number of tasks

invariants: REGISTER_TRANSFORMS contains exactly 5 transforms: direct, casual, technical, academic, narrative
BENCHMARK_TASKS contains 50 tasks across 6 categories: factual (10), reasoning (10), code (8), analysis (8), creative (6), instruction (8)
Each task dict has keys: category, prompt, accept (list), reject (list)
Accept/reject patterns are case-insensitive substring matches
Reasoning category tasks have special scoring: reject patterns override accept matches
Default delay is 0.3 seconds between API calls
All timestamps are UTC ISO format

data_access.rationale: Calibration runner performs model inference (network I/O), caches results (filesystem writes), and optionally logs progress (stdout)

side_effects.rationale: Makes synchronous API calls to LLM providers via backend.complete()
Persists ModelProfile artifacts to cache directory
Optional verbose logging of benchmark progress
